node.label: Beta-aminoisobutyric aciduria
node.definition: An increased amount of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine. Beta-aminoisobutyric acid is a non-protein amino acid originating from the catabolism of thymine and valine.

evidence.snippet: Multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 3: Beta-aminoisobutyric aciduria (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
